audience: teams who track inventory, jobs and purchase orders with Sortly

useCases.title: Find items that are running low on stock
useCases.text: Lists stock and date alerts and shows which have fired, then reads the quantity and minimum quantity of the items involved.

useCases.title: List what is in a folder with its quantities
useCases.text: Lists the items and folders in a folder, including subfolders if you want, or searches by name, and opens an item for its quantity, price and tags.

useCases.title: See which items changed since a date
useCases.text: Lists items and folders changed since a time you give, to see what moved since yesterday.

useCases.title: Check open purchase orders and what was received
useCases.text: Lists purchase orders by number or status, reads one with its lines (quantity against received quantity) and checks its latest receive status.

useCases.title: Update an item's quantity or name, or move stock
useCases.text: Sets a new quantity after a stock count, renames an item, or moves part or all of its quantity to another folder.

useCases.title: Record the stock a job uses
useCases.text: Creates a job, pulls items into it to record usage, and returns items from it to inventory when they are not used.
